Name: Milk of Myth Expanded
Author: GrayH00die
Description:
[heading][center][size=5][size=5][color=orange]Contents of the official version[/color](1.1.5) [color=yellow][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21999]Milk Of Myth[/url][/color] [color=orange]and REDUX of the original mod[/color] [color=yellow][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/341]Monster Girl Livestock[/url][/color][/size][/size][/center]
[/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/7dS7nhX2/Animal-Girls.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Fixed old bugs.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Rabbits now have a 40% chance of dropping Easter Eggs.(You need high friendship with animal)[/size][size=5]These eggs can be used to make Chocolate Spread.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]The Void Chicken Girl is now sold in the Shadow Shop.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shadows have been improved.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Added sleep frames.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=blue]Blue[/color] [color=orange]and[/color] [color=yellow]Gold[/color] [color=orange]Chicken Girls[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/QFCVL1zx/Chicken-Girls.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]The Blue Chicken Girl can be purchased from Marnie's shop after the 8[img]https://i.ibb.co/n88hdtK/Heart.png[/img] event with Shane. Suspicious Blue eggs can also be purchased at Joja-Mart after this event.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Suspicious Golden eggs are sold at Marnie's or Qi Gem shop after reaching 100% perfection. Can be purchased for 10 Golden Eggs or 200 gems.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Ostrich Girls[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/nNKnjPSK/Ostrich-Girls.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Suspicious Ostrich Egg can be purchased for 10 Ostrich Eggs at the Island shop. You can make Suspicious Ostrich Mayonnaise from them.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Suspicious Yellow and Pink Ostrich Eggs can be purchased for 15 Ostrich Eggs at the Island shop.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Blonde Ostrich Girl produces cheap feathers, but its eggs are more expensive.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Pink Ostrich Girl produces cheap eggs, but its feathers are more expensive.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Blonde and Pink Ostrich sprites are taken from [color=yellow][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22022]here[/url][/color].[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Dinosaur Girl,[/color] [color=green]Green[/color] [color=orange]and[/color] [color=red]Red[/color] [color=orange]Pepper Rex Girl[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/R4Nwh0cR/Dinosaur-Girls.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Suspicious Dinosaur Eggs, Suspicious Rex Egg, and Suspicious Red Rex Egg are sold at Marlon's shop after you killing 50 Pepper Rexes. (You will receive a Marlon's mail).[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Dinosaur Girl can lay an Rex Egg with 10% chance. (You need high friendship with animal)[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Pepper Rex Girl is a barn animal. Has 40% chance of giving you a Extra Hot Chilli Pepper. You can make a Extra Hot Chilli Sauce out of it.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Beehive Update[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/VvcLjRj/Beehive.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]The Luxury Beehive can be unlocked after killing 80 Insects. (You will receive a Robin's mail).[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]The incubator, auto-grabber, auto-petter and heater sprites are replaced with a honey theme upon entering the room.[/size]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/Pz17tc6P/Beehive-Craftables.png[/img][/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Queen Wasp and Queen Bee[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/WW1FdqjQ/Queens.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Queen Bee and Queen Wasp Larvae unlocked after you build the Luxury Beehive.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Queens have a 30% chance to produce larvae.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]New Big Craftables[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/CsN0Lsj4/Craftables.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Grinding Machine unlock at farming level 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Paper Press, Honey Extractor and Royal Jelly Pump unlock at farming level 8[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]If there is a flower within a radius of 5 cells from the Honey Extractor, the Honey Extractor produces flower honey.[/size][/*]
[/list][*][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Dryad[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/52ktJkS/Dryad.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]The recipe for Dryad Seeds will be unlocked after receiving a mail from the Wizard.[/size][/*]
[*][spoiler][size=5]First, get the seeds of the ancient fruit. Tomorrow you will receive a mail from the Wizard ask you to grow 500 pieces of the ancient fruit crop. Complete the quest and the next day you will receive a mail from the Wizard with the dryad seeds.[/size][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][size=5]Dryad crops grow for 40 days at [b]ANY TIME OF THE YEAR[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]New Cooking[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/yXG3Jhn/Cooking.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Bug Steak in Mustard with Anchovies unlock at mining level 3.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Magic Chocolate Muffin unlock at farming level 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Beetle Meatballs in Extra Hot Chili Sauce unlock at mining level 6.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Fairy Truffles in Wine Sauce unlock at foraging level 10.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Fried Бananas with Сhocolate Filling unlock at foraging level 7.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Cheese Sticks unlock at foraging level 3.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Strawberry Pancakes in Chocolate unlock at farming level 10.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Spicy Udon with Shrimp unlock at fishing level 10.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Deviled Eggs "Bloody Mary" unlock after you get Krobus 10[img]https://i.ibb.co/n88hdtK/Heart.png[/img].[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][center][heading][size=5][size=5][color=orange]New Trinklets[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[/center]
[center][size=5]For trinkets to work, you need a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url][/size][/center]
[center][size=5]Companions can use your weapon's enchantment if you hold it in your hand.[/size][/center]
[heading][size=5][size=5][color=yellow]Lamia[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/yFyKpRSD/Lamias.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5] Lamia Ring unlocked after killing 250 Serpents in Marlon's shop. Price 1 million gold.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Lamia Staff unlocked after killing 50 Royal Serpents in Marlon's shop. Price 5 million gold.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Deals massive damage every 1,5 seconds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]This trinkets only has 1 level and cannot be reforged.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][heading][size=5][size=5][color=yellow]Vampire Queen[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/LD9q5gM0/Vampire-Queen.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Unlocked after killing 200 Bats in Marlon's shop. Price 700 Bat Wings.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Deals a lot of vampire hits and gives you a unique buffs.[img]https://i.ibb.co/cSjMBMS9/Boiling-Blood.png[/img][/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Works extremely perfect with Deviled Egg "Bloody Mary" .[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Has 3 levels.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Level 1 is standard.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Level 2 is unlocked after killing 300 bats.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Level 3 is unlocked after killing 400 bats.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][heading][size=5][size=5][color=yellow]Duggy Girl[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/xSRM0hMH/Duggy-Girls.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Earth Gem unlocked after killing 30 Duggy in Dwarf shop. Price 30 Earth Crystal. [/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Cinder Gem unlocked after you unlocking Earth Gem and killing 15 Magma Duggy in Dwarf shop. Price 600 Cinder Shards.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Breaks rocks and gives unique buffs. [img]https://i.ibb.co/Q7TLVJF0/Duggy-Girl-Buffs.png[/img][/size][/*]
[*][size=5]This trinkets only has 1 level and cannot be reforged.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][center][heading][size=5][size=5][color=orange]Animal Husbandry Mod[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[/center]
[heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Animals[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/jPMSQwHb/AHMMeat.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Animal girls like treats similar to those of regular animals.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Pepper Rex girls love meat.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Queen Wasp and the Queen Bee loves fruits, maple syrup, sugar and honey. Also, Queen Wasp loves meat, and the Queen Bee loves flowers.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][heading][size=5][size=3][color=orange]Animal Husbandry Cooking[/color][/size][/size][/heading]
[size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/XxKTghg6/AHMCooking.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=5]Elite Beetle Stew with Peas in Tomato Sauce unlock at mining level 7.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms unlock at farming level 4.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Pork Rump Steak unlock at farming level 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Shepherd's Casserole with Lamb and Potatoes unlock at farming level 6.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Void Gedlibzhe unlock after you get Krobus 5[img]https://i.ibb.co/n88hdtK/Heart.png[/img].[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Duck in Honey Caramel unlock at farming level 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Julienne with Chicken and Mushrooms unlock at farming level 2.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Flambé Pasta with Harpy Meat unlock at foraging level 10.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Baked Easter Bunny with Oranges unlock at foraging level 6.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Prehistoric Soup unlock at combat level 5.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Rex Ribs Baked in Apricot Marinade unlock at combat level 7.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Delight of Shadows unlock at farming+mining+fishing+foraging+combat level 10. (You will receive mail from the Wizard)[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][heading][size=5][size=5][b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/size][/size][/heading]
